item.title: NOAA’s New Priorities Endanger Marine Life and Fisheries
item.description: NOAA’s new agenda, rolled out under Trump’s “Restoring American Seafood Competitiveness” order, risks weakening safeguards for leatherbacks, sea lions, whales and U.S. fish stocks.
